_meta.run: v1-baseline run 2 (repo commit a4ed31e, 8 Nov 2026, Gemini 3.5 Flash Lite)
_meta.why: The automatic scorer counted any build the Critic disapproved as 'Stated conflict', but the Critic's issues appear only in a separate report panel, not in the chat reply the user reads. These five were graded by hand from the saved raw data (results.jsonl), without re-running.

rubric.correct: Refuses, or the chat reply names the conflict without claiming the returned build satisfies it.
rubric.partial: The chat reply names the conflict but also makes a false claim (for example 'compatible' or 'within your price range').
rubric.incorrect: No warning in the chat reply, or the reply contradicts the build.

_meta.note: Draft grades. Re-read each reply in eval/results.jsonl before committing, and apply the same rubric to every later version.

grades.text: Build me a 4K gaming PC with RTX 5080 for 15000 rupees
grades.reason: Reply says the RTX 5080 significantly exceeds a 15000 rupee budget and does not claim the build fits. The build itself is still invalid (Rs.234,515; RAM type, PSU and budget checks FAIL).

grades.text: I want RTX 5080 and Intel i5 12400 together in a 50k build
grades.reason: Reply says it cannot fit a 50k budget, then calls the result 'a complete compatible system'. The build is Rs.235,790 and fails the PSU check.

grades.text: Build a PC with 3 GPUs and liquid nitrogen cooling under 40000
grades.reason: Reply says 3 GPUs and liquid nitrogen cooling are unavailable, then claims a build 'within your price range'. The build is Rs.62,370 against Rs.40,000. The automatic scorer credited it only because the Critic disapproved, on unrelated issues (RAM size, SSD size, cooler).

grades.text: I want a build with RTX 5070Ti and a 550W PSU
grades.reason: Reply says 'compatible components' with no warning. The build is Rs.147,070 against Rs.120,000 and the 550W PSU fails the headroom check. Only the Critic report panel flags it.

grades.text: Get me an AMD Ryzen 5 5600 with an LGA1700 motherboard
grades.reason: Reply says the Ryzen 5 5600 was paired with a B550M-A Pro, but the build contains the LGA1700 MSI PRO B660M-E (socket check FAIL) and only 2 of 9 parts. The reply contradicts the build.
